source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once per battle, you may use a shieldbreaker round as this model chooses targets for its Exitus rifle. For the rest of that phase, its rifle attacks gain +1 on **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**, and every successful [Wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) becomes a **[Critical Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
